insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated on an unfulfilled order. This change affects the Shopify GraphQL Admin API and is effective as of August 31, 2026. The recalculation is done against the new destination.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should be aware of this change when updating orders through the GraphQL Admin API, as it may impact the order's total cost. They should also ensure their apps handle the updated tax calculations correctly. This change may require updates to existing code that handles order updates, especially when the shipping address is changed. The orderUpdate mutation should be used with caution, and developers should verify the new tax calculations are correct.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations when the shipping address is updated on an unfulfilled order, ensuring they charge their customers the correct amount. This change improves the overall accuracy of order totals.
insight.why_it_matters: This change is important because it ensures accurate tax calculations for orders, which is crucial for merchants to comply with tax regulations and avoid potential financial losses. It also improves the overall reliability of the Shopify platform.

updates.summary: New fields are available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities.

updates.summary: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests, providing more context to make informed decisions.

updates.summary: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, enabling customers to sign in and manage their account directly on the storefront.

updates.title: createdAt is now available on the Customer object in Shopify Functions
updates.summary: Shopify Functions API version 2026-10 adds a createdAt field to the Customer object, allowing for more precise Function logic.

updates.summary: Updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes, ensuring accurate tax calculations.

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.3 and @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.1 patches improve local debugger connections and reliability.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API and Shopify Functions
themes.detail: New fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS, and the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field. Additionally, updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes as of August 31, 2026.

themes.detail: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API, and the shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement for customer accounts.
